Working with the Production Engineering team as an intern for eight weeks to improve existing processes.

- Implementing a 5S system on the production 3D printers. Ensured replenishment, organization, and accessibility. Set up multiple Bambu Lab and Voron for enterprise use, including a custom material system (TurtleBox).
- Designing a digital daily-use standup board using Claude AI — organizing team data more clearly, eliminating redundant reporting, and driving company-wide process improvements.
- Created a GUI for Final Assembly that simplifies switching between Ground Control Station Modes.

<!-- - Eventually, VBN -->

Following Summer 2026, I entered Redwire as a Production Engineering Specialist, continuing many of the above projects, as well as
- Entering the team for Visual Based Navigation for new product development. This entailed major fisheye camera calibration and creating custom playbacks for ensuring camera success.

Working one—on—one with MIT professor Aaron Hillegass to create an open and accessible STEM curriculum with accompanying resources for home-schools and under-privileged students.


==For a full acknowledgement see [here](https://github.com/KontinuaFoundation/sequence/blob/master/ProjectDocs/Acknowledgements.md#arjan-ellingson)==

- Assisting in development of 36 Workbooks on Math, Science, Physics, and Computer Science.
- Building Python automation to validate objectives, detect prerequisite gaps and duplicates, generate draft
quiz PDFs, and support deployment of [public workbook PDFs](https://kontinuafoundation.github.io/).
- Focused research on the following sections:
    - Graph Theory
    - Introductory Computer Science
    - Newtonian Physics
    - Circular Motion
    - Electromagnetism
    - Data Structures in C/C++
    - Linear Algebra Sequence
    - Bitmap and Hexadecimal Chapters
    - Drones, Quadcopters, and Helicopters

As a Lead Instructor at Code Ninjas, I taught students ages 4-16 foundational programming concepts, mentored small groups through project-based learning, and created a supportive environment for developing confidence in coding. I helped students build games and applications while using Python, JavaScript, and C++ to solve problems and communicate technical ideas clearly. I also worked directly with parents to ensure their students were on track with our learning curriculum.
